name: Ahmad Zulkifli
bio:
Ahmad's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for the technical intricacies of racing. After graduating with a degree in mechanical engineering, he volunteered at local racing events, quickly demonstrating a sharp eye for detail and a knack for strategic decision-making. He honed his skills in data analysis and race simulation, eventually landing a role at a smaller team before being scouted by Meyer Shank Racing.

As a strategist, Ahmad is known for his calm demeanor and data-driven approach. He meticulously analyzes track conditions, competitor performance, and weather patterns to formulate race strategies that maximize the team's chances of success. He is a firm believer in empowering his team and fostering open communication, creating a collaborative environment where innovative ideas can flourish. His ability to remain level-headed under pressure has earned him the respect of drivers and engineers alike, making him a valuable asset to the team.

Ahmad is distinctive for his ability to predict tire degradation and how it impacts lap times, a skill he attributes to his deep understanding of vehicle dynamics and his unwavering commitment to thorough preparation.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a receding hairline
physical.description: Ahmad is a man of average height with a slightly stocky build.

quirks: Always carries a worn-out notebook filled with handwritten racing notes.
Insists on drinking green tea before every race session.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
